pages.text: Firelink is a sanctuary. Nothing hostile lingers here, and nothing here can be broken (you're kept in adventure mode inside its walls).$(br2)Here you'll find the bonfire and its shelter, the class statues, the burial gifts, the Merchant and Blacksmith, an anvil and smithing table, and the $(l)Inscription Table$() in the chapel.
Behind the altar waits the sealed gate to $(l)Lordran$().
